problem.title: Segment Sums
problem.statementMarkdown: The linked list contains integer values separated by zero nodes. Return a new list with the sum of each nonempty segment, including segments at either end. Consecutive zero separators create no segment. A segment whose sum is zero still creates a zero node.

examples.explanation: The segments [1, 2] and [4] sum to 3 and 4.
Consecutive separators add no segment; [-1, 1] still creates zero.
An empty list creates no segments.

constraints.text: Each nonempty segment sum fits a signed 32-bit integer.

attribution: Original Quorem statement and fixture corpus, authored for this project.

solutions.explanationMarkdown: Accumulate nonzero values until a zero separator. Track whether the segment contains a value independently of its sum, so a nonempty segment summing to zero is retained. Flush the final segment after the loop.
solutions.complexityNotes: n is the number of input nodes. Auxiliary space excludes the newly allocated result list.

solutions.source: let segmentSums (head:list_node option) = let rec values acc = function None -> List.rev acc | Some (n:list_node) -> values (n.value::acc) n.next in let rec collect total active acc = function [] -> List.rev (if active then total::acc else acc) | 0::xs -> collect 0 false (if active then total::acc else acc) xs | x::xs -> collect (total+x) true acc xs in List.fold_right (fun v tail -> Some {value=v;next=tail}) (collect 0 false [] (values [] head)) None
